[ASSISTANT_SAID] To ensure that web server components are installed when the scale set virtual machines are provisioned, you can use the Azure Resource Manager (ARM) template to modify the extensionProfile section of the template and specify a custom script extension that installs the components.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] You can also upload the configuration script that installs the components and specify its location in the extensionProfile section of the template.

[USER] Question 44 of 50: You plan to move a distributed on-premises app named App1 to an Azure subscription. After the planned move, App1 will be hosted on several Azure virtual machines. You need to ensure that App1 always runs on at least eight virtual machines during planned Azure maintenance. What should you create?  
[USER] Select the correct answer: one virtual machine scale set that has 10 virtual machines instances, one Availability Set that has three fault domains and one update domain, one Availability Set that has 10 update domains and one fault domain, one virtual machine scale set that has 12 virtual machines instances.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To ensure that App1 always runs on at least eight virtual machines during planned Azure maintenance, you should create one virtual machine scale set that has eight or more virtual machine instances.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Therefore, the correct answer is: one virtual machine scale set that has 8 or more virtual machine instances.
